summary: Credit Acceptance filed an 8-K disclosing consent judgments entered September 17, 2026 with attorneys general of 40 states plus the District of Columbia, resolving the January 4, 2023 NY AG suit and a multi-state investigation, with no admission of wrongdoing. Terms: $15.5 million paid to participating attorneys general, $60 million into a consumer-remediation trust, and roughly $634 million of estimated debt relief via waiver of balances for certain accounts open as of December 1, 2025. Five-year collection-practice changes and seven-year disclosure mandates apply, subject to court approval; no incremental charges expected.
